outcome: Poor access to breastfeeding counseling services
cohort: The study included 289,929 lactating mothers who had optimal antenatal care follow-up across Sub-Saharan Africa.
finding: Nearly one in two women with optimal antenatal care follow-up in Sub-Saharan Africa had poor access to breastfeeding counseling services, with both individual and community-level factors determining this access.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as a significant determinant, with certain modes being associated with higher odds of poor access to breastfeeding counseling services.
